title: Factorial ratio asymptotic equivalent
statement: Fix a positive natural number $r$. As the natural number $k$ tends to infinity, the ratio $\\frac{(rk)!}{(k!)^r r^{rk}}$ is asymptotic to $\\frac{\\sqrt{2rk\\pi}}{(\\sqrt{2k\\pi})^r}$; that is, the quotient of these two quantities tends to $1$.
